readme: R10 experimental tapered choir allocation. Reproduce with python build.py (matplotlib, shapely). INPUTS.json bundles the recovered F5ZK-B plan authority and R08 assembly. Q2-Q5 source quadrilaterals are rigidly translated; no scaling or profile fitting. Midpoints derive linearly from the source station endpoints, consistent with the independent Q3 numerical sample. North/south tapered cells retain full dimensions. Inter-row lanes are 320 in the project Y direction, not certified perpendicular masonry thicknesses. These lanes are space allocations, not continuous floor walls or finished pier footprints. R09 stepped Q1/Q2 bounds are applied. Ordinary/major longitudinal node footprints and continuity across the remaining gaps still need explicit checking; a complete masonry plan is not claimed. No chevet connection is made and no original model is altered. The recovered R3 endpoint is historical evidence, not restoration of the discarded outer ring. No structural validation; F5ZL-C remains missing. Native numerical coordinates are 1:1; physical metre conversion unresolved. Governance was read earlier in this ongoing workflow.
